title: make test can never be green on this host: TestTheBuiltBinaryExitsTwo and the runstate maintenance fixture both fail at the base
body: internal/cli's TestTheBuiltBinaryExitsTwo exits 1 with 'read the gate configuration: open .../internal/cli/.tick/runners.toml: no such file or directory' instead of exit 2 'no executor configured', and internal/runstate's TestTheStoresFetchStartsNoMaintenanceInTheRepositoryItWritesTo reports 'a plain git fetch in the armed repository started no maintenance; this fixture proves nothing' (the armed-repo premise does not hold for this host's git). Both reproduce at a37122fd with this tick's changes stashed, so they block nothing here — but any future full-suite gate run on this host will fail on them.
